known.title: Cache the shared JavaScript emitted by the API build
Exclude nested web build output from lint
Keep pagination reachable when the current page becomes empty

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - rebuild after removing compiled output while retaining the Nx cache. The API compiler also emits `dist/libs/shared/src/index.js`, which the compiled controllers require, but this output declaration caches only `dist/apps/api`. A cache hit therefore restores the controllers without their shared runtime module, and `start:prod` fails with a missing-module error. Include the emitted shared directory in the cached outputs. [Nx restores declared output artifacts on cache hits](https://nx.dev/docs/kb/configure-outputs).
findings.title: Cache the shared JavaScript emitted by the API build

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 4 (floor: migration)
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - run the starter tests after `npm run build`. Vite writes bundled JavaScript into `apps/web/dist`, while `dist/**` excludes only the root output directory. Consequently, `eslint .` checks the generated dependency bundles and fails before the API and browser tests run. The stack test command preserves this directory too. Exclude nested build output explicitly. [Flat-config ignore patterns are relative to the configuration file](https://eslint.org/docs/latest/use/configure/migration-guide#ignoring-files).
findings.title: Exclude nested web build output from lint

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - create 21 projects, visit page 2, and delete its only project. The refreshed query retains `page=2` and returns no items. This condition then hides both pagination buttons and displays “No projects yet,” although 20 projects remain. Following the Projects navigation link preserves the same route state. Clamp the page after deletion or keep pagination available for an empty current page.
findings.title: Keep pagination reachable when the current page becomes empty
